home.title: WFTools — Zvishandiso Zvemahara ze-Intaneti
home.metaDescription: Zvishandiso zvemahara ze-intaneti: jenareta ye-QR nebhakodhi, kudzvanya nekushandura mifananidzo, kubatanidza/kupatsanura ma-PDF, mushandurwi we-JSON/XML/CSV/Excel, mubairo, chikwereti, BMI, chitupa chenguva, kuverenga shure nezvimwe. Inoshanda mubhurauza yako, hapana kunyoresa.
home.lead: Sarudza chishandiso uchishandise pakarepo mubhurauza yako. Hapana kunyoresa, uye dhata yako haimbobudi muchishandiso chako.
home.keywords: zvishandiso ze-intaneti, zvishandiso zvemahara, jenareta yekodhi ye-QR, jenareta yebhakodhi, mudzvanyi wemifananidzo, zvishandiso ze-PDF, mushandurwi wemafaera, kalkuleta yemubairo, BMI, zvishandiso zvewebhu

edu.desc: Zvitupa zvenguva, mibvunzo, kuvapo, mepu dzepfungwa nemubairo.

time.desc: Wachi, kuverenga shure, nzvimbo dzenguva, mazuva ebasa nejenari.

dev.desc: Ronga fomati, tarisa, vanza uye shandura kodhi yekwakabva.

text.name: Zvishandiso zveZvinyorwa
text.desc: Chinja mavara makuru nemadiki, mavara akanaka eshamwari dzepaindaneti, shandura zvinyorwa kuita izwi uye nyora nezwi.

calc.name: Makarkuretari neKushandura
calc.desc: Karkuretari yesayenzi, zvikamu pamusoro pe100 nekushandura zvikero.

random.name: Zvisina Kurongwa neKusarudza
random.desc: Tenderedza vhiri nekusarudza nhamba zvisina kurongwa kumitambo nemipiro.

device.name: Kuongorora Zvishandiso
device.desc: Edza webcam yako, rekodha screen, yera kumhanya kwekunyora nekudzvanya pasekondi.

media.name: Odhiyo neVhidhiyo
media.desc: Pfupisa vhidhiyo, tora odhiyo yeMP3 uye gadzirisa gitare muburauza.

image-convert.name: Dzvanya Mufananidzo
image-convert.desc: Deredza saizi yefaira remufananidzo uye dzvanya mifananidzo mizhinji panguva imwe kuti itakure nekukurumidza pawebhu nepaimeyili.

image-format.name: Shandura Fomati Yemufananidzo
image-format.desc: Shandura mifananidzo pakati peJPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, BMP ne-ICO (favicon) yewebhusaiti, maapp kana kuchengeta.

image-base64.name: Mufananidzo Uve Base64
image-base64.desc: Shandura mifananidzo ive tambo dze-Base64 kuti uiise muHTML, CSS kana kodhi, uye shandura Base64 uve mifananidzo zvakare.

bg-remove.name: Bvisa Shure Yemufananidzo
bg-remove.desc: Bvisa shure chena kana yemavara akafanana pamifananidzo yezvinhu, marogo nema-avatar, pakarepo pachishandiso chako.

watermark.name: Wedzera Chiratidzo Chemvura Pamifananidzo
watermark.desc: Wedzera tsamba, rogo kana chiratidzo chekodzero yekupepeta pamufananidzo mumwe kana mizhinji panguva imwe.

pdf-merge.name: Batanidza Nekupatsanura PDF
pdf-merge.desc: Batanidza mafaera mazhinji e-PDF kuita rimwe, bvisa mapeji aunoda, kana kupatsanura PDF peji nepeji.

pptx-pdf.name: PowerPoint ↔ PDF
pptx-pdf.desc: Shandura masiraidhi e-PowerPoint (.pptx) kuita PDF uye shandura mafaera e-PDF kuita PowerPoint.

file-diff.name: Enzanisa Mafaera Maviri
file-diff.desc: Tsvaga misiyano pakati petsamba mbiri: TXT, Word, HTML kana PDF yetsamba. Zvikamu zvakawedzerwa, zvakabviswa nezvakachinja zvinoratidzwa.

text-analysis.name: Kuongorora Tsamba
text-analysis.desc: Verenga mazwi, mavara, mitsara nemirongo, ongorora nguva yekuverenga nekuwanda kwemazwi makuru patsamba, mafaera eTXT, Word kana PDF.

data-convert.name: Shandura JSON, XML, CSV, Excel
data-convert.desc: Shandura dhata pakati peJSON, XML, CSV ne-Excel (.xlsx) nekuona tafura.

bmi-bmr.name: Kalkuleta Ye-BMI Ne-BMR
bmi-bmr.desc: Verenga chiyero chehuremu hwemuviri (BMI), chiyero chechiuno-chiuno nemakarori anodiwa (BMR, TDEE) nezera, murume kana mukadzi nehuwandu hwekushanda.

meal-calo.name: Chirongwa Chekudya Kwezuva Nezuva Nemakarori
meal-calo.desc: Rongera kudya maererano nechinangwa chemakarori, tarisa makarori ezvokudya zvakajairika uye enzanisa puroteni, makabhohaidhiretsi namafuta.

water-tracker.name: Muteveri Wemvura Inomwiwa
water-tracker.desc: Isa chinangwa chezuva nezuva uye nyora kuti unomwa mvura yakawanda sei, nekufambira mberi nenhoroondo yemazuva akawanda.

calo-burn.name: Makarori Anopiswa Nebasa
calo-burn.desc: Ongorora makarori anopiswa nemitambo, basa, nguva nehuremu hwemuviri uchishandisa kukosha kwe-MET.

cycle-track.name: Muteveri Wemuzungu Wemwedzi
cycle-track.desc: Nyora uye ufanofungidzira muzungu wako wemwedzi, zuva rekuburitsa zai nenguva yekubata pamuviri. Dhata inogara pachishandiso chako chete.

study-timetable.name: Chitupa Chenguva Chekudzidza
study-timetable.desc: Gadzira chitupa chenguva chemakirasi evhiki nenguva; chidhinde kana kuchichengeta kuti uchishandise zuva roga roga.

quiz-bank.name: Mibvunzo Nebhengi Remibvunzo
quiz-bank.desc: Gadzira bhengi remibvunzo ine sarudzo dzakawanda, sanganisa mibvunzo, tora bvunzo yekudzidzira ine mamaki, uye udhinde bvunzo nemhinduro.

attendance.name: Kuvapo
attendance.desc: Gadzira runyorwa rwekirasi, tora kuvapo pasesheni imwe neimwe uye tevera kusavapo nekuuya mushure menguva. Inogona kuwirirana neGoogle Sheets.

mindmap.name: Mepu Yepfungwa Nepfupiso
mindmap.desc: Dhirowa mepu dzepfungwa dzezvidzidzo uye pfupisa tsamba refu pachayo kuita pfungwa huru.

teaching-pay.name: Maawa Ekudzidzisa Nemubairo
teaching-pay.desc: Nyora masesheni ekudzidzisa, verenga maawa ose nemubairo nemutengo, uye uburitse chitatimendi.

fullscreen-clock.name: Wachi Yeskrini Yakazara
fullscreen-clock.desc: Wachi huru yedhijitari yeskrini yakazara ine sutopuwachi nekuverenga shure, mavara anogona kuchinjwa, mavara emunyoreri uye fomati yemaawa 12/24.

countdown-video.name: Muvhidhiyo Wekuverenga Shure
countdown-video.desc: Gadzira taimu yekuverenga shure inogona kugadziridzwa uye uidhawunirodhe sevhidhiyo kuti uiise mumaklip ako.

world-clock.name: Wachi Yepasi
world-clock.desc: Ona nguva yazvino munyika dzakawanda panguva imwe uye enzanisa misiyano yenzvimbo dzenguva pakati padzo.

workdays.name: Kalkuleta Yemazuva Ebasa
workdays.desc: Verenga mazuva ebasa pakati pemazuva maviri, usingaverengi Mugovera, Svondo nemazororo ehurumende.

journal.name: Jenari Yekuintaneti
journal.desc: Nyora jenari yezuva nezuva inochengetwa pachivande musipredishiti yako yeGoogle, inoverengwa newe oga.

code-format.name: Ronga JS, HTML, CSS, JSON
code-format.desc: Ronga zvakanaka nekubvisa kusaita kodhi yeJavaScript, HTML, CSS neJSON.

code-check.name: Mutariri Wesintaksi
code-check.desc: Tsvaga kukanganisa kwesintaksi nechimiro muJavaScript, HTML, CSS neJSON, nemutsetse nekoramu.

js-obfuscate.name: Muvanzi weJavaScript
js-obfuscate.desc: Isa tambo mukodhi, chinja mazita emisiyano uye vanza JavaScript kuti ive yakaoma kuverenga nekukopa.

rsa-keys.name: Makiyi eRSA Nekuvanza
rsa-keys.desc: Gadzira mapeya emakiyi eRSA (PEM), vanza tsamba nekiyi yeveruzhinji uye vhura nekiyi yakavanzika, zvese pachishandiso chako.

text-to-html.name: Tsamba Yakarongedzwa Kuenda ku-HTML
text-to-html.desc: Gadzirisa sezvauri kuona nekusimbisa, misoro, runyorwa, matafura nezvinongedzo, uye uwane kodhi yeHTML yakachena.

inventory.name: Sitoko Nemitengo
inventory.desc: Isa mitengo yekutengesa maererano nemitero yemusika, zvekushambadza nefaindo. Tevera sitoko inopinda neinobuda nemambombo esitoko diki.

invoice.name: Inivhoisi Nemutengo Wakataurwa
invoice.desc: Gadzira mitengo yakataurwa neinivhoisi dzekutengesa dzine rogo, huwandu hunozviita pachahwo nemari yakanyorwa nemazwi. Dhinda kana kuchengeta se-PDF.

menu-qr.name: Menyu Ye-QR
menu-qr.desc: Gadzira menyu yedhijitari yezvitoro zvekudyira nemakefi. Vatengi vanosikena kodhi ye-QR kuona zvokudya nemitengo.

barcode.name: Jenareta Yebhakodhi
barcode.desc: Gadzira mabhakodhi eCode 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A neCode 39 emalebhoro ezvinhu nemasitoro.

loan.name: Kalkuleta Yechikwereti
loan.desc: Muripo wemwedzi, riba rose nechirongwa chekubhadhara chechikwereti chedzimba, mota nevatengi.

compound.name: Riba Rinowedzera Nekuchengeta
compound.desc: Ongorora kuti uchaunganidza zvakawanda sei nekuchengeta kana kuisa mari mwedzi wega wega.

salary.name: Mubairo Usina Mutero ↔ Une Mutero
salary.desc: Shandura mubairo we-Gross uve Net uye kudzosera, uchitevera mitemo ye-2026 yeinishuwarenzi nemutero wemari yemunhu (Vietnam).

qr-code.name: Jenareta Yekodhi Ye-QR
qr-code.desc: Gadzira makodhi e-QR ezvinongedzo, tsamba, Wi-Fi, imeyili nenhamba dzefoni. Dhawunirodha se-PNG kana SVG.

utm.name: Muvaki Wechinongedzo Che-UTM
utm.desc: Wedzera makodhi ekutevera ndege kuzvinongedzo kuti uone kuti vashanyi vako vanobva kunzira ipi.

colors.name: Pareti Yemavara Nemakodhi
colors.desc: Vaka pareti yakananga kubva pavara rekutanga uye uwane makodhi eHEX, RGB, HSL nemisiyano yeCSS.

expense.name: Mari Inoshandiswa Nebhajeti
expense.desc: Nyora mari inopinda neinoshandiswa zuva nezuva, ona mashandisirwo nemhando uye isa miganhu kuti urambe uri mubhajeti.

rsa-keys.pubPh: Dzvanya "Gadzira peya itsva yemakiyi" kana isa kiyi yeveruzhinji ye-PEM (-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----) pano, wobva wadzvanya "Shandisa peya yemakiyi yawaisa".
rsa-keys.privPh: Kiyi yakavanzika ye-PEM (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----). Kiyi iyi inodiwa kuvhura.
rsa-keys.status.none: Gadzira kana isa peya yemakiyi pamusoro. Kiyi yeveruzhinji inokubvumira kuvanza; kiyi yakavanzika inokubvumira kuvhura.
rsa-keys.plainPh: Nyora tsamba pano; tambo yakavanzwa inoonekwa kurudyi.
rsa-keys.cipherPh: Kana isa tambo yakavanzwa pano kuti uivhure kuita tsamba.
rsa-keys.note: Zvese zvinoshanda mubhurauza yako kuburikidza neWeb Crypto uye hazvimbotumirwi kupi nekupi. Nekuti RSA inogona kungovanza dhata pfupi chaizvo zvakananga, chishandiso chinoshandisa kuvanza kwakasanganiswa: chinogadzira kiyi ye-AES isina kurongwa kuvanza tsamba, wobva wachiputira kiyi iyoyo ye-AES neRSA — saka tsamba yeurefu hwupi hwoga hwoga inogona kuvanzwa. Anogamuchira anoda kiyi yakavanzika inoenderana kuti avhure. Kiyi yeveruzhinji (SPKI) inogona kugovaniswa; kiyi yakavanzika (PKCS#8) inofanira kuchengetwa chivande.
rsa-keys.status.ready: Zvakagadzirira: nyora tsamba yekuvanza, kana isa tambo yakavanzwa kuti uvhure.
rsa-keys.status.pubOnly: Kiyi yeveruzhinji iripo: unogona kuvanza. Hapana kiyi yakavanzika, saka haugone kuvhura parizvino.
rsa-keys.status.privOnly: Kiyi yakavanzika iripo: unogona kuvhura. Hapana kiyi yeveruzhinji, saka haugone kuvanza parizvino.
rsa-keys.err.genHint: Bhurauza inofanira kutsigira Web Crypto (shandisa Chrome, Edge, Firefox kana Safari itsva).
rsa-keys.err.pastePem: Isa kiyi yeveruzhinji kana yakavanzika ye-PEM mubhokisi riri pamusoro.
rsa-keys.err.pubRead: Hazvina kukwanisika kuverenga kiyi yeveruzhinji. Inoda fomati chaiyo ye-PEM yekiyi yeveruzhinji (-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----, SPKI).
rsa-keys.err.privRead: Hazvina kukwanisika kuverenga kiyi yakavanzika. Inoda fomati chaiyo ye-PEM yekiyi yakavanzika (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----, PKCS#8).
rsa-keys.status.noPub: Hapana kiyi yeveruzhinji, saka haugone kuvanza. Gadzira kana isa kiyi yeveruzhinji.
rsa-keys.status.noPriv: Hapana kiyi yakavanzika, saka haugone kuvhura. Isa kiyi yakavanzika inoenderana.
rsa-keys.status.badFormat: Tambo yakavanzwa haisi mufomati yechishandiso ichi.

typing-test.texts: Mangwanani ega ega ndinomuka nekukurumidza ndoenda kunomhanya ndakatenderera dziva. Mhepo itsva inoita kuti musoro wangu ujeke uye inondigadzirira zuva idzva kubasa. Mushure mezvo ndinodya kudya kwemangwanani nemhuri yangu, ndoverenga mapeji mashoma ebhuku ozotanga zuva rangu. Tsika diki dzinodzokororwa zuva nezuva dzinowedzera kuita shanduko huru nekufamba kwenguva.|Zimbabwe ine nzvimbo dzakasiyana-siyana, kubva kuVictoria Falls inonakidza kusvika kumakomo eNyanga nekuGreat Zimbabwe yekare. Vashanyi vanogona kuona Matobo Hills, kunakidzwa nemimhanzi yeHarare kana kufamba mumigwagwa ine vanhu vazhinji yeBulawayo. Dunhu rega rega rine hunhu hwaro.|Kudzidza kunyora uchishandisa minwe yose isina kutarisa kibhodhi hunyanzvi hunobatsira munhu wese anoshanda nekombuta. Kana wazvijaira, haachadi kutarisa kibhodhi, kumhanya kwako kunokwira uye unoita zvikanganiso zvishoma. Dzidzira kwemaminiti angangoita gumi nemashanu zuva rega rega, tarisa kururama kutanga wozowedzera kumhanya zvishoma nezvishoma.
typing-test.typeHere: Nyora pano (nguva inotanga paunodzvanya kiyi yekutanga)
typing-test.howTo: WPM = mazwi akarurama paminiti (mavara mashanu akanyorwa nenzira kururama anoverengwa seizwi rimwe). Mazinga: 40 WPM yakanaka, 60 WPM inokurumidza, pamusoro pe80 WPM inokurumidza zvikuru.

cps-test.info: CPS (kudzvanya pasekondi) ndiko kuwanda kwekudzvanya kwaunoita pasekondi rega rega. Vazhinji vanosvika pa6–7 CPS; vatambi vanodzidzira jitter kana butterfly clicking vanogona kusvika pa10–14 CPS. Mhedzisiro yako inochengetwa pamudziyo wako chete.
cps-test.restartIn: dzvanya zvakare mushure mesekondi 1 kuti utambe zvakare

webcam-test.privacy: Vhidhiyo inoratidzwa pamudziyo wako chete; hapana chinorekodhwa kana kutumirwa kupi nokupi. Mifananidzo yekuedza inogara papeji iri kusvika wadhawunirodha.
webcam-test.noApi: Bhurauza iri haritsigire kamera, kana peji risiri kushanda neHTTPS. Shandisa Chrome, Edge, Firefox kana Safari itsva.
webcam-test.errDenied: Kushandisa kamera kwakavharirwa. Dzvanya icon yelokhi pedyo nekero yepeji, bvumira Kamera, woodzvanya Batidza kamera zvakare.
webcam-test.errNotFound: Hapana kamera yakakodzera yawanikwa. Tarisa kuti yakabatanidzwa uye haina kudzimwa nehotkey, kana sarudza kujeka Kwakaotomatiki.
webcam-test.errBusy: Kamera iri kushandiswa neimwe app (Zoom, Teams, Skype…). Vhara app iyoyo woedza zvakare.
webcam-test.errOther: Hatina kukwanisa kutanga kamera. Edza zvakare kana tangisa bhurauza yako patsva.
webcam-test.name: Zita rekamera

screen-recorder.ph: Hausi kurekodha. Dzvanya Tanga kurekodha uye sarudza skirini, hwindo kana tabhu.
screen-recorder.sysAudio: Rekodha odhiyo yesystem / tabhu (sarudza "Share audio" kana bhurauza ichikubvunza)
screen-recorder.note: Kurekodha skirini kunoshanda muChrome, Edge, Firefox neSafari padesktop; mafoni haasati atsigira. Mavhidhiyo anochengetwa zvakananga pamudziyo wako, haaiswe paintaneti. Fomati ndeye MP4 kana bhurauza yako ichitsigira, kana zvisina ndeyeWebM (inovhurika muChrome, VLC); kuti uwane MP4 unogona kuishandura nechishandiso cheVideo Compressor.
screen-recorder.noSupport: Bhurauza iri haritsigire kurekodha skirini. Shandisa Chrome, Edge, Firefox kana Safari pakombuta.
screen-recorder.errStart: Hatina kukwanisa kutanga kurekodha. Edza zvakare.
screen-recorder.errMic: Hatina kukwanisa kushandisa maikirofoni (yakavharirwa kana haipo). Kurekodha kuri kuenderera pasina izwi rako.

guitar-tuner.tips: Zano: donha tambo imwe panguva, rega iridze zvakasikwa uye chengeta chigadzirwa padyo nemaikirofoni. Kana museve wakadzvanyira kuruboshwe tambo yakaderera (isimbise); kana wakadzvanyira kurudyi tambo yakakwira (ibudise). Mukati me ±5 cents yagadzirwa.
guitar-tuner.errDenied: Maikirofoni yakavharirwa. Dzvanya icon yelokhi pedyo nekero yepeji, bvumira Maikirofoni, woedza zvakare.
guitar-tuner.errMic: Hatina kukwanisa kuvhura maikirofoni. Tarisa kuti yakabatanidzwa uye haisi kushandiswa neimwe app.

password-gen.noAmb: Dzivisa mavara anofanana (O 0 o I l 1)
password-gen.cap: Isa mavara makuru pazwi rega rega
password-gen.ppNote: Mitsara isina kurongwa yakareruka kurangarira asi yakaoma kufungidzira, yakanakira password huru yemanejara yemapassword kana yekombuta yako.
password-gen.privacy: Mapassword anogadzirwa nekuongororwa pamudziyo wako nejenareta yakachengeteka yebhurauza yako; hapana chinotumirwa kupi nokupi kana kuchengetwa.
password-gen.pickSet: Sarudza rudzi rumwe rwemavara kana kupfuura
password-gen.tipYear: Dzivisa makore ekuzvarwa kana mamwe makore anofungidzirwa.
password-gen.tipReuse: Usashandise password imwe pamasaiti akasiyana; manejara yemapassword inobatsira.

signature.drawTip: Isa siginecha nemausi, stylus kana chigunwe mukati mebhokisi. Pafoni, i tendeudze kuti iwane nzvimbo yakawanda.
signature.name: Zita rizere
signature.fontNote: Mimwe mavara ekunyora noruoko haatsigire zvizere mavara ane maakisendi; kana maakisendi akaipa, sarudza Dancing Script, Great Vibes, Allura, Pacifico kana Caveat.
signature.legal: Siginecha yako inogadzirwa pamudziyo wako uye haitumirwi kupi nokupi. Mufananidzo wesiginecha mugwaro hausiyane nesiginecha yedhijitari inobvumirwa nemutemo pazvinodiwa.

logo-maker.svgNote: Faira reSVG rinotakura Google Fonts paintaneti; kana uchiiisa musoftware yekugadzira isa mavara akafanana, kana shandisa PNG huru. Logo yaunogadzira ndeyako, asi tarisa kuti haifanane netrademark yakanyoreswa usati washandisa pabhizimisi.
logo-maker.name: Zita rebhizimisi

notepad.welcomeBody:
Nyora manotsi ako pano. Shanduko ipi neipi inochengetwa otomatiki mubhurauza rino.

Zano: dzvanya "Notsi itsva" kuwedzera dzimwe, shandisa bhokisi rekutsvaga kusefa, wodhawunirodha se .txt kana uchiida pamumwe mudziyo.
notepad.open: Vhura faira re .txt kana kuridonhedza pano
notepad.privacy: Manotsi anochengetwa mubhurauza rino chete pamudziyo uyu (haaenderane kumwe kunhu). Kucheneswa kwedhata yebhurauza kunoadzima, saka dhawunirodha manotsi akakosha.
notepad.full: Nzvimbo yebhurauza yapera. Dhawunirodha uye dzima mamwe manotsi ekare.
notepad.tooBig: Faira rinopfuura 2 MB uye harigoni kuvhurwa munotipedhi.

image-resize.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG. Mifananidzo yakawanda panguva imwe, yega yega isingasviki 40 MB.
image-resize.keep: Chengeta chiyero chechimiro (siya bhokisi rimwe risina chinhu kuti ritorwe)

image-crop.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG; usingasviki 40 MB. Unogona kunamata neCtrl+V.
image-crop.tip: Kwevera furemu kuti uritamise, kwevera mabhokisi emakona/mativi kuti ushandure saizi. Miseve inofambisa 1 px (Shift: 10 px). Denderedzwa rinochengetwa sePNG isina mashure.

image-to-pdf.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP. Kusvika mifananidzo 200, yega yega isingasviki 40 MB.
image-to-pdf.dragTip: Kwevera mifananidzo kuti urongezve mapeji, kana shandisa mabhatani e ◀ ▶. Mifananidzo inogadziriswa pamudziyo wako.
image-to-pdf.err: Hatina kukwanisa kugadzira PDF. Edza zvakare.

pdf-to-image.dropTitle: Sarudza faira rePDF kana kurikwevera pano
pdf-to-image.dropHint: Kusvika 200 MB. Faira rinogadziriswa pamudziyo wako.
pdf-to-image.err: Hatina kukwanisa kushandura peji iri. Edza kujeka kwakaderera.

pdf-compress.dropTitle: Sarudza faira rePDF kana kurikwevera pano
pdf-compress.dropHint: Kusvika 200 MB. Faira harisiyi pamudziyo wako.
pdf-compress.lLightD: mifananidzo inoramba yakada kufanana neyekutanga, kudzikira kudiki
pdf-compress.lMediumD: mifananidzo inoramba yakajeka, kudzikira kukuru; zvinyorwa hazvibatwi
pdf-compress.lStrongD: diki, mifananidzo isina kujeka zvakanyanya; zvinyorwa hazvibatwi
pdf-compress.lExtremeD: peji rega rega rinoshanduka kuita mufananidzo; diki zvikuru, asi zvinyorwa hazvigone kusarudzwa kana kukopwa
pdf-compress.note: MaPDF ane zvinyorwa zvakawanda (akabudiswa muWord) anowanzova madiki kare uye anodzikira zvishoma; maPDF ane mifananidzo yakawanda kana masikena ndiwo anodzikira zvikuru. Kana mhedzisiro isiri diki, edza Wakasimba kana Wepamusoro.
pdf-compress.noImgs: Hapana mifananidzo yeJPEG yekupfupisa; marongerwo efaira agadziriswa.
pdf-compress.notSmaller: Faira rapfupiswa harina kuda kufanana neyekutanga. Sarudza mwero wakasimba, kana faira iri rakagadzirwa kare.

pdf-to-word.dropTitle: Sarudza faira rePDF kana kurikwevera pano
pdf-to-word.dropHint: Kusvika 100 MB, mapeji 300. Faira rinogadziriswa pamudziyo wako.
pdf-to-word.mTextD: ndima nemisoro zvaunogona kugadzirisa; marongerwo akaoma (matafura, makoramu) anogona kufamba
pdf-to-word.mImageD: peji rega rega rinova mufananidzo muWord, rakafanana neyekutanga asi risingagadziriswe
pdf-to-word.mBothD: mifananidzo yemapeji pamwe nezvinyorwa pazasi pazvo zvekukopa
pdf-to-word.scanNote: MaPDF akasikenwa (mifananidzo yemapeji) haana zvinyorwa chaizvo; shandisa chishandiso cheMufananidzo kuenda Kuzvinyorwa (OCR) peji rega rega, kana sarudza "Chengeta murongerwo wepeji".
pdf-to-word.noText: Hapana zvinyorwa zvakawanikwa mufaira iri (pamwe ndeye sikena). Sarudza "Chengeta murongerwo wepeji" kana shandisa chishandiso cheOCR.

word-to-pdf.dropTitle: Sarudza faira reWord (.docx) kana kurikwevera pano
word-to-pdf.dropHint: Kusvika 50 MB. Faira rinoverengwa pamudziyo wako, harisiyi.
word-to-pdf.print: Dhinda / Chengeta PDF ine zvinyorwa zvakajeka
word-to-pdf.note: "Dhawunirodha PDF" inogadzira PDF pakarepo (peji rega rega mufananidzo wemhando yepamusoro). "Dhinda / Chengeta PDF ine zvinyorwa zvakajeka" inovhura dhairogi rekudhinda: sarudza printer ye "Save as PDF" kuti uwane PDF ine zvinyorwa zvinosarudzwa nekutsvakwa. Marongerwo akaoma (misoro, nzvimbo dzepasi, mabhokisi ezvinyorwa, machati) angasiyana negwaro rekutanga.
word-to-pdf.oldDoc: Mafaira ekare e .doc (Word 97-2003) haasati atsigirwa. Avhure muWord, uachengete se .docx, woedza zvakare.
word-to-pdf.err: Hatina kukwanisa kugadzira PDF. Edza bhatani reDhinda / Chengeta PDF.
word-to-pdf.printTip: Sarudza printer ye "Save as PDF" kuchengeta faira.

pdf-sign.dropTitle: Sarudza PDF yekusaina kana kuikwevera pano
pdf-sign.dropHint: Kusvika 100 MB. Faira harisiyi pamudziyo wako.
pdf-sign.tip: Sarudza siginecha, wodzvanya papeji kuiisa. Kwevera kuitamisa, kwevera sikweya yepakona yepazasi kushandura saizi, dzvanya × kana Delete kubvisa. Siginecha yemufananidzo iyi inokodzera mapepa enguva dzose; haitsive siginecha yedhijitari kana ichidikanwa nemutemo.
pdf-sign.upHint: Mufananidzo wesiginecha yako pabepa jena (JPG, PNG)
pdf-sign.emptySig: Hapana siginecha parizvino. Dhirowa, nyora zita rako kana isa mufananidzo.

pdf-edit.dropTitle: Sarudza faira rePDF kana kurikwevera pano
pdf-edit.dropHint: Kusvika 100 MB. Faira harisiyi pamudziyo wako.
pdf-edit.tip: Sarudza chishandiso, wodzvanya papeji kuiisa. Dzvanya zvinyorwa kuzvigadzirisa, kwevera kuzvitamisa, kwevera sikweya yepakona yepazasi kushandura saizi, dzvanya Delete kubvisa. Cherechedza: "Bhokisi dema/Fukidza chichena" zvinofukidza zvirimo nemaziso chete; zvinyorwa zvekutanga zviri pazasi zvinoramba zviri mufaira. Kubvisa chaizvo ruzivo rwakakosha, shandisawo Pfupisa PDF pamwero Wepamusoro (unoshandura mapeji kuita mifananidzo).
pdf-edit.unicodeLocked: Minda ine zvinyorwa zvine maakisendi kana zvisiri zveChilatini yakanyorwa zvakananga papeji (minda iyi haichagone kugadziriswa).

image-ocr.dropTitle: Sarudza mifananidzo kana PDF yakasikenwa, kana kuikwevera pano
image-ocr.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, PDF. Unogonawo kunamata skirinishoti neCtrl+V.
image-ocr.enhance: Jekesa mufananidzo usati wawuverenga (mifananidzo isina kujeka, zvinyorwa zvidiki)
image-ocr.note: Kuziva kunoitirwa mubhurauza yako; kekutanga kunodhawunirodha injini nedhata yemutauro (anosvika 5–20 MB pamutauro), kuchienderera kunokurumidza. Mifananidzo yakajeka ine zvinyorwa zvakadhindwa pamashure akareruka ndiyo inoshanda zvakanaka; kunyora noruoko kunoomesera kuziva.
image-ocr.max3: Sarudza mitauro isingapfuuri 3 kuti uziviswe nekukurumidza nekururama.
image-ocr.pdfLimit: Mapeji ekutanga 50 chete ePDF ndiwo akawedzerwa.
image-ocr.noText: Hapana zvinyorwa zvakawanikwa. Edza mufananidzo wakajeka zvikuru, mutauro wakarurama, kana batidza kujekesa.
image-ocr.errNet: Hatina kukwanisa kudhawunirodha injini yekuziva kana dhata yemutauro. Tarisa intaneti yako woedza zvakare.

heic-jpg.dropTitle: Sarudza mifananidzo yeHEIC kana kuikwevera pano
heic-jpg.dropHint: Mifananidzo ye .heic / .heif kubva paiPhone kana iPad. Yakawanda panguva imwe, yega yega isingasviki 50 MB.
heic-jpg.note: Mifananidzo inoshandurwa pamudziyo wako. Kekutanga, chishandiso chekuverenga HEIC (anosvika 1.5 MB) chinodhawunirodhwa. MuLive Photos furemu huru chete ndiyo inochengetwa. Ruzivo rwenzvimbo yeGPS kubva kuyekutanga haitakurwi.
heic-jpg.notHeic: haisi mufananidzo weHEIC. Kumifananidzo yenguva dzose yeJPG/PNG shandisa chishandiso cheConvert Image Format.
heic-jpg.errNet: Hatina kukwanisa kudhawunirodha chishandiso chekuverenga. Tarisa intaneti yako woedza zvakare.
heic-jpg.errDecode: Hatina kukwanisa kuverenga mufananidzo uyu (faira rakaparara kana rudzi rweHEIC rusingatsigirwe).

image-upscale.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP. Mifananidzo midiki, isina kujeka kana yekare ndiyo inobatsirwa zvikuru.
image-upscale.mX4c: inobvisa kukanganisa kweJPEG, yemifananidzo yakachengetwa paintaneti
image-upscale.note: AI inoshanda pamudziyo wako; mifananidzo haitumirwi kupi nokupi. Kekutanga inodhawunirodha modhi ye5–20 MB. Mifananidzo inogadziriswa mumatayera madiki, saka mikuru ingatora maminiti mashoma; Chrome kana Edge itsva inokurudzirwa (inokurumidza zvikuru neWebGPU).
image-upscale.err: Hatina kukwanisa kushandisa AI mubhurauza rino. Edza Chrome kana Edge itsva.

video-compress.dropHint: MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI. Zvakanakisa pasi pe300 MB (kusvika 500 MB).
video-compress.note: Vhidhiyo inopfupiswa mubhurauza yako ne ffmpeg uye haiiswe paintaneti. Kekutanga, chishandiso (chinosvika 31 MB) chinodhawunirodhwa. Kupfupisa kunoshandisa CPU, saka kunononoka kupfuura software yedesktop: vhidhiyo yeminiti rimwe inowanzotora maminiti 1–5. Siya tabhu iyi yakavhurwa kusvika yapera.
video-compress.tooBig: Vhidhiyo inopfuura 500 MB, zvinopfuura zvinogona kuitwa nebhurauza. Ichekei kutanga.
video-compress.errCode: ffmpeg haina kukwanisa kugadzirisa vhidhiyo iyi (fomati isinganzwisisiki kana faira rakaparara).
video-compress.notSmaller: Vhidhiyo yapfupiswa haina kudzikira (yekutanga yapfupiswa zvakanaka kare). Sarudza Wakasimba kana kujeka kwakaderera.

video-to-mp3.dropHint: MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI, FLV… Kusvika 1 GB.
video-to-mp3.note: Inogadziriswa mubhurauza yako ne ffmpeg; vhidhiyo haiiswe paintaneti. Kekutanga, chishandiso (chinosvika 31 MB) chinodhawunirodhwa. Tora odhiyo chete kumavhidhiyo aunekodzero yekushandisa.
video-to-mp3.tooBig: Faira rinopfuura 1 GB, zvinopfuura zvinogona kuitwa nebhurauza.
video-to-mp3.badTime: Nguva isina kukodzera. Shandisa maminiti:masekondi, semuenzaniso 1:30; mhedziso inofanira kuva mushure mekutanga.
video-to-mp3.noAudio: Hatina kukwanisa kutora odhiyo. Vhidhiyo ingangoda kusava nenzwi kana kushandisa fomati isingatsigirwe.
